payload.title: QTS Data Centers Announces Major Expansion in Sidney, Ohio
payload.snippet: QTS Data Centers plans a 200 MW hyperscale campus along the I-75 corridor in Shelby County, Ohio, leveraging low-cost utility power and available land.

payload.title: Shelby County Commissioners Approve Rezoning for I-75 Industrial Park
payload.snippet: The Shelby County Board of Commissioners approved rezoning of 450 acres along State Route 47 near I-75 for heavy industrial use, enabling large-scale data center development.

payload.title: AEP Ohio Files Utility Agreement for Sidney Data Campus
payload.snippet: AEP Ohio submitted a large-load service agreement to the PUCO for a proposed data center campus in Sidney, Ohio, totaling approximately 180 MW of peak demand.
